facts.F1: Story #6360 S03b Package Work Items, nwdes feature A of three (rules first). facts.F16: Formal verification: no checker selected, no model written or run. No state, transition, protocol, concurrency or recovery behaviour changes. Rule and membership claims are finite and decided exactly by the compiled IL with a made-up offender as falsifier; the refresh-preservation claim compares the code with itself, so literal expected values at the service port are the honest falsifier. Liveness not applicable: synchronous rule evaluation and a one-shot capture have no progress property. Property-based testing not applicable: every law is a finite enumeration of rules, types, refresh scenarios and named endpoints; the test-writing skill decides test density.
facts.F17: Carriers, all test-side: rule verdicts are KernelRuleVerdict, InboundVerdict and OutboundVerdict owned by ModuleRules and KernelRules; dependency facts are IlDependent from IlDependencies; per-fixture state is the lazily read Mono.Cecil ModuleDefinition disposed at one-time teardown; the refresh oracle holds a ServicePortHarness per scenario; the compare script holds captured bodies in a temp directory. Layers: application rules only; no adapter, infrastructure or recovery layer changes.
